sentences.text: UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following O R D E R

The petitioner is seeking bail pending trial in First Information Report No.194 of 2022 registered against him under Sections 363 and 366 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 at Police Station Shahpur, District Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh.

Upon completion of investigation,
charge- sheet was filed against the petitioner under Section 363, 366, 376 of IPC and Sections 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (for short 'POCSO Act')

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: As far as stage of trial is concerned, it is admitted that 2, out of 5 witnesses have been examined and evidence of the third witness is going on.

Considering the aforesaid fact, in our view, the only relief at this stage the petitioner can be granted is direction to the Trial Court to expedite the trial and make an endeavour to conclude the same within a period of six months from the next date of hearing.
In case the trial is not the concluded, the petitioner can file a fresh application.
With the aforesaid observations, the Special Leave Petition is dismissed.
Pending applications also stand disposed of.

(ANITA MALHOTRA) (AKSHAY KUMAR BHORIA)
